_doc: PROBE pointer table (Z1 reconciliation, arc2-loop1-round4). In-repo pinneable citations only, per the round claim: NO line numbers into operator-mutable files. Config citations are graded by their CONTENT-ANCHOR FORM (the stanza key `[mcp_servers.rea]` or the named receipt), never by a live line number. Entry kinds: `exact` (the citing line itself must match), `extracted` (read the cited line number out of the citing line and verify the NAMED target holds the claim), `anchor` (content must appear; a hit off the pinned line is `citation_moved`). `quoted` marks an append-only record whose words must stay verbatim -- a record of a refuted/dead claim is never a failure and never 'repaired'. `stamp` marks a receipt-qualified pointer: dead-at-HEAD reads `citation_historical_ok`, not failed.
